shopware_types_on_http: Any event_type from the Shopware v3 enum is rejected by this schema and must also be rejected by ingest with HTTP 422 even if a caller posts a valid rabbitmq payload.
source: const nextjs; aggregate_type and aggregate_id are not part of the envelope
attribution_touch: Only session_started may carry UTM and GCLID/GBRAID/WBRAID. Shopware must not publish those fields.
payment_methods_shown: payload.methods is an array of technical keys; Analytics stores one payment_method_events row per key.
pii: Raw name, email, phone, address and message text are forbidden.
sales_channel_allowlist: Unknown sales_channel_id is rejected at ingest from settings, not from this schema. Browser origin must match the channel origins list.
money: Decimal string in payload only. Currency must not appear on the envelope.
consent: Optional snapshot. Shopware envelopes have no consent field; Analytics stores null for those events.
